assemble.help: Move the JDK and Ant into the Eclipse bundle and point eclipse.ini at the bundled VM.

build.help: Run the whole bundle pipeline: fetch, assemble, install plugins, package.

fetch-eclipse.help: Download and extract the Eclipse platform for this host.

fetch-jdk.help: Download and extract the IBM Semeru JDK for this host.

image.help: Build the container image carrying this host's bundle (Linux only).

install-plugins.help: Install the manifest's install units via the Eclipse P2 director.

package.help: Package the assembled bundle into a distributable archive.

reset.help: Remove the working directory (downloads, extractions, the packaged bundle) and start over.

install.help: Extract the packaged bundle into a directory on this machine.

up.help: Run a container from the image built for this host (Linux only).

image-coordinates.help: Print the image repository, version and multi-arch reference as shell assignments.

publish.help: Attach this host's packaged bundle to the GitHub release for these component versions.

publish-bundle.help: Push this host's packaged bundle to the container registry as an OCI artifact.

publish-image.help: Push the container image to the registry (Linux only).

publish-manifest.help: Join the per-architecture images into one multi-architecture tag.

completion.help: Regenerate the product's shell completion from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).

install.help: Provision the host tooling the kernel needs - today oras; idempotent.

auth-scopes.help: Grant the stored gh token the package scopes GHCR needs (interactive, idempotent).

prune-branches.help: Delete local branches already merged into main (squash-aware via gh).

submodules.help: git submodule update --init lib/platform (init the submodule a fresh worktree needs).

catalogue.help: List the task coordinates the delivery kernel offers, marking the namespaces this product's commands reach.

generate.help: Regenerate the product's CLI module from its manifest (--check reports drift and writes nothing).
